mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 9.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or signal predictive power is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During supply-driven recessions (INDPRO < 95.0 and UNRATE > 9.0%), declining industrial production combined with rising unemployment signals reduced corporate output capacity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In supply-driven recession regime, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or signal predictive power is not significant (p>0.05) over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY) signals rising input costs and potential central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0, or signal Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates severe labor market contraction, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery (GDPC1 growth > 1.0% quarterly), rising residential construction (HOUST) signals strong housing demand, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In post-recession recovery regime, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises, or signal Rank IC < 0.02.
